cards.title: Hidden Power
cards.instruction: Act publicly modest while making choices as though you control the outcome.

cards.title: Retroactive Permission
cards.instruction: Get approval for something you have already done.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: No need to put me in charge. Would you support a small improvement to the front garden?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'm merely helping this reach the right outcome. Something with a pond. And no tree.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Let's finish agreeing before the stump grinder leaves.
